_about: What his hooves do: grabbing, lifting, holding, dragging, throwing, swinging and bashing, and what a stone or a slam does.

THROW_ENERGY.about: Rocks and stones: his arms put the same energy into every throw, THROW_ENERGY joules for each kilogram of him (times the strength of his arms), so the speed is the square root of twice that over the stone's weight. A heavy rock is a short, slow lob; a light stone would fly faster than an arm can move, and leaves at ARM_SPEED (times the root of his strength) at the most.

ARM_SPEED.about: the fastest a stone or a spear leaves his hoof, m/s, for arms of ordinary strength

PEBBLE_KG.about: what a pebble weighs, in kg

PEBBLE_RADIUS.about: how big a pebble is, in metres

LIGHT_STONE.about: in kg: a stone lighter than this knocks nothing over: it stings, startles (the animal runs for PEBBLE_FRIGHT seconds) and makes a fox drop what it stole. A stone or a rock harms by all the energy it flies with, a hard blow (see ENEMY_HEALTH in animals.json)

PEBBLE_FRIGHT.about: seconds, at random in this range, an animal a pebble startles runs off for

AIM_RANGE.about: how far off he can pick something out to throw at

ANIMAL_THROW_GAIN.about: for animals, which he can wind up

MAX_THROW.about: the fastest anything he throws or swings can go, m/s

MAX_THROWN.about: stones and spears in the air at once, a count

WIND_TAP.about: What F does with something in his hands. A tap (let go within WIND_TAP seconds) puts it down. Held longer, he winds up: the throw has WIND_LEAST of its full speed at first and all of it after WIND_FULL seconds.

WIND_FULL.about: seconds of winding up for a throw at full speed

WIND_LEAST.about: the share of full speed a throw has with no winding up at all

GRAB_REACH.about: how far beyond touching he can reach: about an arm

LIFT_TIME.about: seconds to lift something of his own weight

CARRY_DRAIN.about: stamina per second for holding his own weight

LIFT_LIMIT.about: he can swing or throw up to this share of his own weight

ARM_LIFT.about: kg of rock he can lift for each kg of his arm muscle: an ordinary Prosio (5 kg of arm muscle) 40 kg, the strongest arms (12 kg) 96 kg, arms wasted away (3 kg) 24 kg. A rock heavier than that stays on the ground ("Way too heavy to lift!"). Raise it and he lifts heavier rocks

HEAVE_TIME.about: seconds to heave up a rock at the most he can lift; a lighter one in proportion (a 10 kg rock, for an ordinary Prosio, half a second)

HEAVE_COST.about: stamina to heave up a rock at the most he can lift, on top of 6 for any; a lighter one in proportion. Held, a rock also weighs on him the more the nearer it is to his limit: at it, as much again as it weighs

ROCK_DENSITY.about: A rock of radius 0.3 weighs about 10 kg, 0.6 about 82 kg, and the big boulders (0.9) about 280 kg: liftable only by a heavy, rested Prosio.

DIG.about: an animal on its feet digs in: it resists like this many times its weight

DRAG_SLIDE.about: a limp animal slides along the grass: it resists like this share of its weight

PROSIO_GRIP.about: and Prosio digs his heels in too

LUNGE_SPEED.about: how much faster a dragged animal pulls when it lunges

ARM_LEN.about: from his shoulder to his hoof, arm outstretched

skipping._about: A body slammed down spinning skips on along the ground.

SKIP_KEEP.about: share of forward speed kept at each skip

SKIP_BOUNCE.about: share of falling speed that bounces back up

SKIP_SPIN.about: share of falling speed the spin turns into forward speed

FOLLOW_THROUGH.about: seconds his arm stays down after a swing lands

LIMP_MOST.about: seconds an animal bashed about hangs limp, at most

CLUB_SHARE.about: A held animal slammed into the ground or anything solid harms itself by the energy of the part of its body behind the blow (CLUB_SHARE of its weight) at the speed it hit, a soft blow. Whatever the swung animal hits takes a share of its speed set by their weights, as when two balls collide. But the club is floppy: only part of its body (CLUB_SHARE of its weight) is behind the blow, and it squashes rather than bounces (restitution BASH_BOUNCE). For a club of weight m moving at v, striking something of weight M: it flies off at   (1 + e) * m' / (m' + M) * v,   with m' = CLUB_SHARE * m the club goes on  (m' - e * M) / (m' + M) * v So a turkey swung into a turkey knocks it about half as fast as it was swung, and swung into the billy goat it barely rocks it and bounces back.

BASH_BOUNCE.about: how bouncy the swung animal is when it strikes (e in the sums above, 0 to 1): raise it and what it hits flies off faster and it bounces back more

rocks._about: How rocks are drawn: which models, and how tall one may be against its radius.

ROCK_PLAIN.about: A rock of radius r with its middle at m, drawn from one of the rock models (packed from assets/trees/<name>.glb by tools/pack_assets): which one goes by the rock's number in the world (index), so it keeps its shape when he lifts and throws it, and a mossy rock keeps its moss. No taller than ROCK_TALL times its radius.

ROCK_MOSSY.about: the models a mossy rock is drawn from

ROCK_TALL.about: a rock is drawn no taller than this many times its radius
